verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly cover the hardware media engines. They describe enhanced AV1 and H.265 support and new 4:2:2 H.264/HEVC encode with improved HEVC/AV1 quality. The Video Codec SDK adds 4:2:2 progressive/interlaced encode, doubled NVDEC H.264 throughput with 4:2:2 decode, and AV1 NVENC quality comparable to software at ~3X throughput. Creator acceleration is described only in general terms (3D modeling, animation, virtual production, rendering, video). Missing for 10: named creator-app (ISV) acceleration or professional/ISV-certified driver documentation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of encoder quality or performance.
